rows.title_full: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A TONDO PUBLIC LIBRARY TO BE KNOWN AS SENTRO NG KARUNUNGAN LIBRARY TO BE LOCATED IN TAYUMAN, TONDO, MANILA AND APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR
rows.status: Substituted by HB06780

committee_action.action: Approved by the Committee on Appropriations on 2009-06-02

rows.title_full: AN ACT ADOPTING MAHARLIKA AS THE NEW NAME FOR THE COUNTRY IN LIEU OF THE PHILIPPINES
rows.abstract: Seeks to wipe out the last vistege of the country's colonial mentality by doing away with name that stigmatizes the nobility of our beginning and character as a people thus in substance and identity, we can so live with a new name of our nation, revealing the kind of people we are yesterday and today, noble and free.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on REVISION OF LAWS since 2009-04-13

rows.title_full: AN ACT EMPOWERING PROVINCIAL GOVERNMENTS TO ADMINISTER LAND RECLAMATION IN THEIR AREA OF JURISDICTION, MAXIMIZE THEIR UTILIZATION AND PROVIDE FOR THEIR DEVELOPMENT CONSISTENT WITH PUBLIC INTEREST AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: Seeks to give flesh on the provision of the Local Government Code by empowerering the provincial governments to undertake and administer land reclamation they may deem necessary in their area of jurisdiction that are consistent with public interest.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on LOCAL GOVERNMENT since 2009-04-13

rows.title_full: AN ACT SEPARATING ALCANTARA NATIONAL HIGH SCHOOL - BADIAN EXTENSION IN THE MUNICIPALITY OF BADIAN, PROVINCE OF CEBU, FROM ALCANTARA NATIONAL HIGH SCHOOL, CONVERTING IT INTO AN INDEPENDENT NATIONAL HIGH SCHOOL TO BE KNOWN AS BADIAN NATIONAL HIGH SCHOOL, AND APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on BASIC EDUCATION AND CULTURE since 2009-04-13

rows.title_full: AN ACT AMENDING SECTION 24 OF REPUBLIC ACT NO. 7916, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE \"SPECIAL ECONOMIC ZONE ACT OF 1995\"
rows.abstract: Seeks to grant the province where the economic zone is situated a share of one and a half (1 1/2%) per cent in the gross income derived by the businesses enterprise of whatever nature operating within the economic zone (ECOZONE).
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on ECONOMIC AFFAIRS since 2009-04-13

rows.author: F094
rows.title_full: AN ACT IN RELATION TO THE LIABILITY OF OWNERS FOR DOG BITES
rows.abstract: Subjects the owner of the dog to damages thus encouraging the dog owners to act responsibly in taking their dogs out in public and in allowing interactions between their dogs and the people on their property thereby reducing the number of serious injuries resulting from dog bites and preventing the spread of rabies.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on JUSTICE since 2009-04-13

rows.author: F094
rows.title_full: AN ACT TO DIRECT THE SECRETARY OF TRANSPORTATION AND COMMUNICATION TO STUDY AND ESTABLISH A MOTOR VEHICLE SAFETY STANDARD THAT PROVIDES FOR MEANS OF ALERTING BLIND AND OTHER PEDESTRIANS OF MOTOR VEHICLE OPERATION
rows.title_short: Pedestrian Safety Enhancement Act Of 2009
rows.abstract: \"Pedestrian Safety Enhancement Act of 2009.\" Seeks to direct the Secretary of the Department of Transportation and Communication (DOTC) to promulgate a motor vehicle safety standard and establish a method for alerting blind and other pedestrians of the presence and operation of nearby motor vehicles to enable such pedestrians to travel safely and independently in urban, rural and residential environments.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on TRANSPORTATION since 2009-04-13

rows.author: F094
rows.title_full: AN ACT AUTHORIZING ENGINEERS TO DISCLOSE TO ANY GOVERNMENTAL OFFICIAL INFORMATION REGARDING A BUILDING OR STRUCTURE THAT HE BELIEVES IN GOOD FAITH MAY POSE A DANGER TO THE PUBLIC HEALTH OR SAFETY
rows.title_short: Professional Engineer's Disclosure Act
rows.abstract: \"Professional Engineer's Disclosure Act.\" Seeks to prohibit a contract between an engineer and building owner from containing any provision that would limit or interfere with the engineer's right to provide that disclosure and would also prohibit a building owner from threatening, initiating or maintaining legal action against, or otherwise retaliating against an engineer due to that disclosure or the engineer's ability to make that disclosure.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on LOCAL GOVERNMENT since 2009-04-13

rows.author: F094
rows.title_full: AN ACT MAKING AUTOMATED TELLER MACHINES ACCESSIBLE TO THE VISUALLY IMPAIRED
rows.title_short: Atm Visually Impaired Friendly Act
rows.abstract: \"ATM Visually Impaired Friendly Act.\" Seeks to require the Banking Institution that owns an Automated Teller Machine (ATM) to install a non-visual method facility for reading or relaying the sequence of messages that appear on the screen of the machine, aside from the braile labels that they are currently using.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on SOCIAL SERVICES since 2009-04-13

rows.author: E017
rows.title_full: AN ACT TO STRENGTHEN THE IMPLEMENTATION OF THE RIGHT AGAINST FORCED EVICTIONS AMENDING FOR THIS PURPOSE PROVISIONS OF THE REPUBLIC ACT NO. 7279 OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE URBAN DEVELOPMENT AND HOUSING ACT OF 1992
rows.abstract: Declares it a State policy to ensure that the human right against forced evictions clearly and explicitly established, which is to be fulfilled and protected by the State in favor of all persons without discrimination.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on HOUSING AND URBAN DEVELOPMENT since 2009-04-13

rows.author: F057
rows.title_full: AN ACT DECLARING OCTOBER OF EVERY YEAR AS \"ANTI-CORRUPTION MONTH\" IN THE ENTIRE COUNTRY
rows.title_short: Anti-corruption Month
rows.abstract: \"Anti-Corruption Month.\" Seeks to mandate all heads of government agencies and instrumentalities, including government-owned and controlled corporations as well as local government units and employers in the private sector to conduct activities designed to create awareness among the people on the adverse effects of corruption.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on GOOD GOVERNMENT AND PUBLIC ACCOUNTABILITY since 2009-04-13

rows.author: F057
rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR A GENERAL REAPPORTIONMENT OF THE LEGISLATIVE DISTRICTS OF THE PHILIPPINES PURSUANT TO THE 2007 CENSUS
rows.abstract: Seeks to reapportion, Pursuant to the 2007 Census, the legislative districts of the Philippines with a minimum population of at least four hundred thousand per district.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on REVISION OF LAWS since 2009-04-13

rows.author: A076
rows.title_full: AN ACT AMENDING SECTION 7 OF REPUBLIC ACT NO. 8794 OTHERWISE KNOWN AS AN ACT IMPOSING A MOTOR VEHICLE USER'S CHARGE ON OWNERS OF ALL TYPES OF MOTOR VEHICLES AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: Seeks to amend section 7 of Act No. 8794 with the end in view of ensuring a more transparent disbursement of the monies collected from vehicle owners so that Motor Vehicles User´s Charge (MVUC) will be used to improve motoring in the country.
rows.status: Change of committee referral requested on 2009-05-11

committee_action.action: Change of committee referral requested on 2009-05-11
committee_action.meethigh: Requested that the said measure be jointly referred to the Committee on Appropriations.

rows.author: F014
rows.title_full: AN ACT INSTITUTING A DRIVER EDUCATION PROGRAM, PROVIDING THE IMPLEMENTING MECHANISMS THEREFOR, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: Seeks to educate the youth on driving before they decide on applying for a driver´s licence to ensure that the drivers have the basic knowledge of driving before they take on the road.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on TRANSPORTATION since 2009-04-13

rows.author: F014
rows.title_full: AN ACT TO DEVELOP AND PROMOTE FILM TOURISM IN THE PHILIPPINES, PROVIDING FUNDS AND INCENTIVES THEREFOR AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: Seeks to highlight the country´s globally competent filmmakers, and promote the country as the prime film tourist destination thereby exempting the film industry from payment of E-VAT and customs duties for the importation of cinema equipment and facilities necessary for their operation and thus encouraging the film tourism industry, accredited film productions, institution and other service providers to actively participating in the said industry.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on TOURISM since 2009-04-13

rows.author: F057
rows.title_full: AN ACT REGULATING FOREIGN PROGRAMMING THROUGH THE GRANTING OF LANDING RIGHTS, DESIGNATING THE NATIONAL TELECOMMUNICATIONS COMMISSION AS THE APPROPRIATE REGULATORY BODY AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: \"Landing Rights Act of 2009.\" Seeks to grant the National Telecommunications Commission (NTC) the power of jurisdiction and regulation over all foreign programs through granting of Landing Rights to foreign programmers as well as authority to resolve any and all disputes between foreign programmers and cable TV operators, thereby ensuring no-discriminatory access to appropriate and desirable  content under the framework of transparency and fair play, for the full attainment of the progress and development of the country's economy and preservation and enrichment of our culture.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on PUBLIC INFORMATION since 2009-04-13

rows.author: F094
rows.title_full: AN ACT REQUIRING THE POSTING OF CALORIE COUNT INFORMATION ITEMS IN MENU BOARDS OF FOOD SERVICE ESTABLISHMENTS
rows.title_short: Calorie Count Menu Act Of 2009
rows.abstract: \"Calorie Count Menu Act of 2009.\" Seeks to address the problem of boesity and the diseases that are caused by it.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on HEALTH since 2009-04-13

rows.author: F094
rows.title_full: AN ACT TO ENSURE THAT ALL FILIPINOS HAVE BASIC HEALTH LITERACY SKILLS TO FUNCTION EFFECTIVELY AS PATIENTS AND HEALTH CARE CONSUMERS
rows.title_short: National Health Literacy Act Of 2009
rows.abstract: \"National Health Literacy Act of 2009.\" Seeks to establish within the Department of Health a Health Literacy Implementation Center to enhance efforts of the government to help eliminate the problem of low health literacy by improving measurements, reasearch, development, and information dissemination.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on HEALTH since 2009-04-13

rows.author: F094
rows.title_full: AN ACT TO CREATE A NATIONAL WRITING PROGRAM
rows.title_short: National Writing Program Act Of 2009
rows.abstract: \"National Writing Program Act of 2009.\" Seeks to encourage the cooperation between the government and the private sector in developing a program that will develop the writing skills of the youth.
rows.status: Pending First Reading (Filed last 2009-03-19)

rows.author: E017
rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING ASSISTANCE TO FRESH GRADUATES IN WAIVING GOVERNMENT FEES AND CHARGES COLLECTED IN CONNECTION WITH REQUIREMENTS FOR EMPLOYMENT
rows.title_short: Fresh Graduate Pre-employment Assistance Act Of 2009
rows.abstract: \"Fresh Graduate Pre-Employment Assistance Act of 2009.\" Seeks to provide access to fresh graduates desirous of decent employment without necessarily requiring them to pay for the many clearances and documents required of them by their prospective employers through reasonable waiver of the fees collected by government for these clerances, licenses and other documents from them.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on LABOR AND EMPLOYMENT since 2009-04-13

rows.title_full: AN ACT CONSOLIDATING THE LAWS ON CHILD ADOPTION, PROVIDING PENALTIES FOR VIOLATION THEREOF, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.title_short: Child Adoption Act Of The Philippines
rows.abstract: \"Child Adoption Act of the Philippines.\" Aims to correct the prevailing imblance in the attention provided to inter-country adoption as compared with local adoption and toensure that adequate resources are available for the domestic adoption promotion and services.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on JUSTICE since 2009-04-13

rows.author: F094
rows.title_full: AN ACT PUNISHING THE CRIME OF TAMPERING WITH A TAXIMETER
rows.abstract: Seeks to protect the public from fraudulent activity of taxicab drivers who use taximeter accelerating devices as their means of overcharging passengers in taxicab.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on JUSTICE since 2009-04-13

rows.author: F094
rows.title_full: AN ACT TO IMPROVE LEGISLATIVE DOCUMENT ACCESSIBILITY
rows.title_short: Legislative Document Accessibility Act
rows.abstract: “Legislative Document Accessibility Act.” Seeks to statutorily establish the duty of our legislative bodies to establish and maintain websites that contains legislative information accessible to our constituents.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on PUBLIC INFORMATION since 2009-04-13

rows.author: F094
rows.title_full: AN ACT MANDATING THE DEPARTMENT OF EDUCATION TO INCLUDE DATING VIOLENCE EDUCATION IN THE PHYSICAL EDUCATION, HEALTH AND MUSIC (PEHM) CURRICULUM FOR SECONDARY EDUCATION
rows.abstract: Seeks to provide dating violence education to students, parents, staff faculty and administrators, in order to prevent dating violence and to address incidents involving it. The enactment of this policy is in response to several studies that declared that when a student is a victim of dating violence, his or her academic life suffers and his or her safety at school is jeopardized.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on BASIC EDUCATION AND CULTURE since 2009-04-13

rows.author: F094
rows.title_full: AN ACT PROHIBITING THE SITING OF LANDFILLS/GARBAGE DUMPS NEAR EDUCATIONAL FACILITIES
rows.abstract: Seeks to prohibit the issuance of permits for landfills within twenty kilometres from educational institutions to allow a safe environment essential for learning.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on LOCAL GOVERNMENT since 2009-04-13

rows.author: F094
rows.title_full: AN ACT TO REQUIRE THE CONSUMER PRODUCT SAFETY COMMISSION TO PRESCRIBE RULES REQUIRING DISTINCTIVE MARKINGS ON TOY AND LOOK-ALIKE FIREARMS
rows.abstract: Seeks to mandate the Department of Trade and Industry (DTI) to create an acceptable standard on distinctive marking for toy guns and implement such standards to the toy manufacturers to avoid or stop misuse of toy guns by some criminals in committing crimes.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on TRADE AND INDUSTRY since 2009-04-13

rows.author: F057
rows.title_full: AN ACT INCREASING THE MINIMUM SALARY GRADE OF PUBLIC SCHOOL TEACHERS FROM SALARY GRADE 10 TO 20 AND PROVIDING FUNDS THEREFOR
rows.abstract: Seeks to increase the minimum salary grade of public School teachers from salary grade 10 to grade 20 in order to keep up with the high cost of living and to compensate their long working hours so that they can provide better education to children.
rows.status: Change of committee referral requested on 2009-04-15

rows.abstract: Aims to address the lack of finance that will support implementation of numerous programs of government to meet the health needs of the people by allowing its hospitals to utilize their income for their maintenance and other operating expenses instead of remitting their income back to the national treasury.

rows.title_full: AN ACT TO AMEND REPUBLIC ACT NO. 7394 ALSO KNOWN AS THE CONSUMER ACT OF THE PHILIPPINES TO MAKE IT UNLAWFUL TO SELL A RECALLED PRODUCT
rows.title_short: The Consumer Act Of The Philippines
rows.abstract: “The Consumer Act of the Philippines.” Seeks only to prohibit the failure to comply with an order issued by the Department of Health (DOH) to recall, repair, replacement or refund of unsafe products, it seeks to amend the law to make it unlawful to sell a recalled product.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on TRADE AND INDUSTRY since 2009-04-14

rows.status: Pending with the Committee on ECOLOGY since 2009-04-14

rows.title_short: Teach For The Philippines Act
rows.abstract: “Teach for the Philippines Act.” Seeks to establish a program that would engage the cooperation of the private sector in recruiting, training and deployment of teachers to underprivileged communities.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on BASIC EDUCATION AND CULTURE since 2009-04-14

rows.author: F094
rows.title_full: AN ACT PROHIBITING A MANUFACTURER FROM DISTRIBUTING PERSONAL AUDIO PLAYERS UNLESS THERE IS A WARNING LABEL ON THE PRODUCT WHICH PROVIDES THAT IT MAY CAUSE HEARING DAMAGE
rows.title_short: Music Player Noise Warning Act
rows.abstract: “Music Player Noise Warning Act.” Seeks to respond to the harmful volume levels at which users of portable audio players (e.g. MP# players or iPods) are able to listen; prohibits the manufacturer from distributing a personal audio player unless the manufacturer affixes a warning label on the personal audio player.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on TRADE AND INDUSTRY since 2009-04-14

rows.author: F094
rows.title_full: AN ACT TO PROHIBIT TERMINATION OF EMPLOYMENT OF VOLUNTEER FIREFIGHTERS AND EMERGENCY MEDICAL PERSONNEL RESPONDING TO EMERGENCIES
rows.title_short: Volunteer Fire-fighter And Ems Personnel Job Protection Act
rows.abstract: “Volunteer Fire-fighter and EMS Personnel Job Protection Act.” Seeks to prohibit terminating, demoting or otherwise discriminating against volunteer fire-fighters and emergency medical service personnel for their absences while serving, in order to encourage individual to volunteer for emergencies and major disasters; allow them to maintain their regular job while standing by to serve when needed.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on LABOR AND EMPLOYMENT since 2009-04-14

rows.author: F014
rows.title_full: AN ACT ALLOCATING 10% OF THE GROSS INCOME OF ALL LOCAL MOBILE PHONE TEXT MESSAGES SENT FROM THE TELECOMMUNICATIONS COMPANY TO THE FOOD AND EDUCATION PROGRAM OF THE GOVERNMENT
rows.title_short: The 10% Allocating Act Of 2009
rows.abstract: “The 10% Allocating Act of 2009.” In order to balance the interest of the public on the cost of sending text message and the diminution in the earnings of telecommunication companies, this bill proposes that instead of merely lowering the cost of communication through lowered access charges, current rates should be maintained, but with the government collecting ten percent (10%) of the gross revenue, of the telecommunications companies to be used in answering the long-time problem of our country in education, food and malnutrition particularly focusing on elementary school children.  This bill seeks to create a program, the Food and Education Acceleration Program (FEAP) under supervision of DepEd and DOH to spearhead the rehabilitation and acceleration of educational infrastructure in our country as well as to improve the nutrition and health of school children by providing the proper food and nourishment their body needs.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on BASIC EDUCATION AND CULTURE since 2009-04-14
